text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential with monocytosis and basophilia. There is also mild hypoproteinemia. These findings may indicate underlying chronic disease, possible bone marrow dysfunction, or acute infection/inflammation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended, especially regarding respiratory status and hematologic abnormalities.
